about_the_game:
"In New Dawn City, Big Brother doesn't just watch where you are—he watches how you act."

Ava's Redemption is a hardcore Immersive Sim set in a cyberpunk dystopia ruled by the Hermes Corporation. Here, freedom is a capital offense, and algorithmic surveillance is absolute.

You must control two distinct fugitives simultaneously: The Rust Lady, a former chief scientist, and Echo, a mysterious child capable of bending reality. Use mind hacking, electronic disruption, and time rifts to carve a path to freedom.

🎭 True Asymmetric Dual-Play

You aren't just controlling a character; you are managing a tactical squad. Switch instantly between two protagonists with opposing skill sets and vulnerabilities:

  • The Rust Lady (Anti-Human Specialist): Wielding a Neural Interface, she can execute [Mind Hacking] to manipulate human guards—forcing them to patrol elsewhere, drop their weapons, or turn on each other.

  • Echo (Anti-Tech Specialist): He can [Override Systems] to paralyze android sentries or slip through vents too small for an adult. But remember, he is just a child. You must manage his Fear and Hunger. Darkness paralyzes him; fatigue weakens him. Protect him, or your escape ends here.

🧠 Behavioral Camouflage: Social Stealth

Hiding behind crates is for amateurs. In this city, survival means hiding in plain sight. The surveillance AI analyzes your behavioral logic, not just your line of sight:

  • Eye Contact: Staring at a guard or camera for too long triggers suspicion.

  • Movement Logic: Walking in erratic patterns, sprinting suddenly, or loitering without purpose will get you flagged.

  • Environmental Reaction: If it rains and you don't seek shelter like a normal citizen, the AI will know you are a fugitive.

  • Disguise System: Knock out a Scavenger, steal their uniform, and walk past checkpoints. But be warned: elite units like the "Starling" can see right through your act.

⏳ The Time Rift: Weaponize The Fourth Dimension

When all tactics fail, tear reality apart. Use the rare [Time Rift Card] to trigger the ultimate ability: Parallel Selves.

  • Summon Your Future: This is not a simple rewind. You summon a version of yourself from a future timeline.

  • Squad of Four: For a brief window, you control 4 characters simultaneously (Past Ava/Echo + Future Ava/Echo). Use your future selves as bait, or coordinate a synchronized takedown across timelines.

  • Causal Collapse: If any version of you dies, the paradox destroys you. Coordination is key.

🌧️ A Living, Breathing Dystopia

  • Dynamic Weather: A sudden thunderstorm might mask the sound of your footsteps, but the lightning flashes will expose your silhouette in dark alleys.

  • Roguelite Elements: Every escape attempt is different. Enemy patrol routes, key item locations, and secret paths are randomized each run.

  • RPG Progression: Scavenge for [Neural Data] to repair the Rust Lady’s damaged interface. Unlock deep skill trees to enhance your mind control range or upgrade Echo’s hacking protocols.

🔎 Narrative & Multiple Endings

Every corner of New Dawn City holds a secret. Decipher hidden graffiti left by the resistance, but beware of false traps set by the corporation. Your choices matter. Will you comfort a terrified child? Will you spare the guards? Your Humanity and Dissociation levels will determine your ultimate fate.

Will you escape as a human, or upload your consciousness to the network to become a ghost in the machine?

short_description: In a city where machines watch your every move, blending in is your weapon. Swap between a mind-hacking fugitive and a tech-disrupting child. Master 'behavioral camouflage' to hide in plain sight, and tear open Time Rifts to cooperate with your future selves in this immersive cyberpunk stealth sim.
